description:
## Problem (observed, root cause unknown)
During W2 PR C end-to-end runs, `benchbox run --platform clickhouse-local --benchmark tpcds --scale 0.01 --tuning tuned --phases generate,load,power` into a fresh `BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR` failed in data generation with a message ending "refusing to write a manifest that lists no tables" (scan-v1 manifest, "produced no table files"). Generating once with `--tuning notuning --phases generate,load` into the same output directory first made the tuned run work. It happened more than once on macOS (Darwin 27, arm64) and was never reproduced in isolation or root-caused. The fail-loud behaviour is correct (datagen-empty-manifest-vacuous-validation-20261001); the cause of the empty generation is not understood.

## Change
- Reproduce with a clean output directory and capture the datagen log (the dsdgen invocation, working directory, and files produced).
- Find out whether it depends on tuning mode, the output directory being empty, the compression step or tool (zstd), or macOS specifics.
- Fix the cause, add a regression test, and keep the fail-loud check.

## Guardrails
- Do not weaken the empty-manifest validation.
